briefing.headline: Mauricio Pochettino has started as Manchester United head coach, and Liverpool vs Man Utd is the next big match.

points.text: Mauricio Pochettino is Manchester United's new head coach. He spoke to club media for the first time and has agreed terms with the Premier League.
points.label: reported

points.text: Manchester City's ownership faces a blow after US investors scrapped a deal following a guilty verdict. One report says it is worth $2 billion.
points.label: reported

points.text: Florian Wirtz is seen as ready to step up at Liverpool, according to one analysis of his numbers under Klopp and Iraola.
points.label: opinion

points.text: Chelsea under Xabi Alonso have been called inconsistent after 10 Premier League games. Two Sky Sports pieces look back at what has been learnt.
points.label: reported
